THE CAUSE, ONE CLASS: one fact, one answer (the charter's §2) — the town's own drawn record overrides a terrain or institution table, and a fact has one reader. THE MECHANISM: steps/resolveResources.js drops a rolled crossroads_position off crossroads access AFTER the roll and its depletion draws, so the roll itself stands; from steps/assembleInstitutions.js on (the first step that reads the rolled list: each institution's chance is multiplied by its nearby resources) a holder's later steps read a different list, its roster can re-roll, and every later draw on the birth's stream follows: the holder is RE-DEALT from that step on, which is why each family moves both ways.
